Tuition fees for undergraduate students starting in 2027
The tuition fees you must pay if you are starting an undergraduate course in the 2027/28 academic year. There are separate fees for placement years.
Factsheet
Understanding your tuition fees
You pay tuition fees at the beginning of each year. The fee rates depend on your fee status , not your mode of study. If you are an EU national starting in September 2027 your fee status may be Home or Overseas, depending on your circumstances.
Tuition fees are liable to increase annually for all University of Bath students.
You should also budget for extra costs in addition to your tuition fees .
Read about what your tuition fees pay for .
Fees for Home students
If you have Home fee status the University is limited by the maximum fee permitted by the UK government. The fee for the current year is set at the maximum permitted level, and you should expect the University to increase the fee each year in line with the maximum permitted value set by the government for that year - the tuition fees will not increase in any academic year by more than 8% from the previous academic year's tuition fees.
The undergraduate regulated fees for Home students in the 2027/28 academic year are subject to parliamentary approval.
If you aren't paying your fees in British pounds, you should also budget for possible fluctuations in your own currency.

Placement fees and study abroad fees
During a placement, you are away from the University working or studying for at least one continuous academic year.
You will normally pay a reduced tuition fee instead of the full year fee while on a placement period or studying abroad .
Find out why we charge a placement fee .
Placements
Type of placement
Annual fee
All UK and international work placements (paid or unpaid)
To be confirmed by UK government
All overseas study exchanges (10 weeks or more)
To be confirmed by UK government
International work placements, in receipt of Turing Scheme funding
To be confirmed by UK government
For overseas study exchanges, if the study period is less than 10 weeks (with the remaining time being spent on placement), the year counts as work.
For international work placements, the outcome of applications for Turing funding will not normally be confirmed until after the start of the placement year. Therefore, all students on international work placements will initially be charged the higher amount. If successful, applicants will receive a partial rebate once their Turing status is known.
Fees for overseas students
You should budget for an increase of up to 8% for every year of your course.
If you aren't paying your fees in British Pounds, you should also budget for possible fluctuations in your own currency.

Legal information
These fees are for the academic year 2027/28 only. Tuition fees are liable to increase annually for all University of Bath students.
UK undergraduate fees are regulated by the government. These fees are subject to parliamentary approval.
If you are an EU national starting in September 2027 your fee status may be Home or Overseas, depending on your circumstances.
You should budget for an increase of up to 8% each year for every further year of study; we will not increase your fees each year by more than this percentage and the amount will be set out on our fee page by June for the following academic year.
Fees for students who started before 2027
If you started your course before 2027, find the tuition fees you need to pay this academic year .
